issues.reason: (Measure sk_eat_1 duration 1 night) asserts the eating itself lasted a night, which the container adverbial "in one night" does not state, and the instruction set expressly bars this head for a frame adverbial ("never (Measure e duration ...), which would claim the eventuality itself lasted that long").

gaps_confirmed: container / frame time adverbial "in <n> <unit>" - the span within which an event completes, plus its per-period rate reading on a habitual; Measure duration is barred, WithinLast is backward-window only, and Every / TimesPer need a stated period or rate wording
defect_summary: No head in the vocabulary carries "the eating completed within a span of one night", so the compliant parse emits the event atoms without the frame adverbial - the same handling the instruction set prescribes for adverbials with no licensed slot ("leave them out and record the gap") - and records the gap rather than mis-slotting it as a duration.
notes: Everything else checks out: a witness for the indefinite "one sky-cat" under a verbal predicate, CardinalityPhrase "many" licensed because the phrase counts things rather than a proportion, Patient for eat, and both compound genera emitted with the noun modifiers (sky, night) correctly unexposed.
